page.notes: Syriac and Hebrew words are rendered as placeholders where the glyphs could not be reliably transcribed; the Syriac and Hebrew type should be checked against the scan. The Greek "σὴς" is a reading of "σής". Faint show-through from the reverse page was ignored.
